notes.title: Tomomi News!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36608637/ea9eeec7fd16018a1ca9b966d901d16b92d98d19.png

Hello all!

It's been a little while since I've posted an update regarding the game on here but rest assured things have been very busy!

Here's what has been going on:

We've been getting some awesome new game art created!

We've got a brand new user interface!

We've got voice acting!

We've got a brand new CG and some background work!

AND

We've got an entirely new demo route written for the game! It's got some callbacks to the original demo you may have played, but this one is written to make a little bit more sense and overall flow better than the old one.

We're hoping to release this demo sometime next month.
If you're interested at all, please do join our Discord Server to keep updated on things as they happen!

You can also check out our new website for the game!

notes.title: Join Our Discord!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36608637/4c04b91bbda0b3afab07aa47d37350ad013bd590.png

Join Dodo's Discord server!
If you want to keep yourself up to date on Tomomi and all other future projects from developer Dodo then there is no better place! Found a bug that you want to report- or maybe you had a question about the project that you want a more immediate answer to?

Dodo's Server on Discord!


What's going on with development?

Well that is an excellent question and one I am only too happy to answer!

Things have admittedly been slow since the demo of Tomomi was released, and even then it was released in a rushed and partially incomplete state. This is because I have been working super hard on the next release in the series of the game, Tomomi: Chapter 1- which will be coming in late July. 

If you liked Tomomi in the demo then you'll love her in this upcoming release! We are expecting to have the release fully voiced by the wonderful Fae Lalune as Tomomi with amazing CG art by our sprite artist, Arctic Fox!


Good things are coming!

Thank you for taking the time to read this small announcement! Tomomi is coming and it will be fantastic, I promise you that! This has been such a great experience for me, developing and communicating with other devs throughout my time working on the game. This game really is my passion project, I love it so much and I can not wait to see where the series will go!

-Dodo ♡
